# fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai : Fix the Page, a Chrome extension

> One generic Chrome extension that fixes the page you are on, only when you ask, built on
> activeTab. It touches a tab only when the user invokes it there, keeps nothing it does not
> need, and can say exactly what it changed. Version 0.1 ships one fix: the tab's title, in
> set, prefix, suffix and template modes, on demand or persistently per site.

Site and extension version: v0.1.0 (24 October 2026). A child of the hub
chrome-extensions.sgit.ai. Code Apache 2.0; content CC BY 4.0. No network calls, no telemetry.

## The one rule

The extension touches a page only because the user asked it to, on that page, and it can say
exactly what it changed. Hence: activeTab instead of host permissions; fixes as declarative
rules, not code; per-site opt-in for persistence; a visible list of every rule and every site
with access, each removable; no network calls.

## Pages

- [Home](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/index.md): what it is, the rule, how a fix reaches a page, what it does not do, the roadmap.
- [Install](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/install/index.md): from a clone of the repository or from the zip; chrome://extensions, Developer mode, Load unpacked.
- [The title fix](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/use/title/index.md): modes, match patterns, always on a site, undo, My rules, the export format.
- [Permissions](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/permissions/index.md): activeTab, scripting, storage, contextMenus, optional host permissions, each in Chrome's words.
- [Privacy](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/privacy/index.md): nothing leaves the browser; what is stored and where.
- [Source and releases](https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/source/index.md): the files, the zip and SHA-256, the validator, the tests.

## Facts an agent may need

- Manifest V3. permissions: activeTab, scripting, storage, contextMenus. optional_host_permissions: https://*/*, http://*/*. No host_permissions. CSP: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'.
- Rules: { id, match (Chrome match pattern), fix: "title", value, mode: set|prefix|suffix|template, created, enabled }, in chrome.storage.local under "rules". Export format: { format: "fix-the-page/rules", version: 1, exported, rules }.
- Release: https://fix-the-page.chrome-extensions.sgit.ai/releases/fix-the-page-v0.1.0.zip with .sha256 beside it.
- Repository: https://github.com/SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__Chrome-Extension__Fix-The-Page
- Origin: the newsroom article "Fix the page yourself", https://newsroom.sgit.ai/articles/fix-the-page-yourself.html
